description: This file implements the SugarCache class responsible for managing caching in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for initializing cache backends, resetting opcode caches, file cache invalidation, and external cache API functions.

classes.name: SugarCache
classes.description: Manages caching layers, cache initialization, and cache invalidation procedures, including integration with opcode caches.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Discovers and initializes cache backend classes from specific directories, selecting the one with the highest priority.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the cache backend, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: cleanOpcodes
methods.description: Clears various opcode caches based on available PHP extensions and configurations.

methods.name: cleanFile
methods.description: Invalidates the cache for a specific file in opcode caches.

methods.name: cleanDir
methods.description: Removes cache entries for all PHP files within a specified directory.

methods.name: isOPcacheEnabled
methods.description: Checks if PHP's OPcache is enabled.
